It's like, dude, look what Kevin is doing. Fucking Kevin, we had arguments, is Kevin the best power forward versus Tim Duncan? Like those are real arguments. And now Kevin is doing Channing Frye things to win. So brother, we all got to eat less, but we're all going to eat at the buffet at the end of it.

Knowing the Nets didn't have success before I got there, to be able to help them be successful, I made a prediction, I think it was just to be .500, 41 and 41, and the media thought that was funny, but that was just being average.
